messages:
maria: Heads up — Zenith POC streaming is flapping during the demo. Client sees truncated JSON / parse errors and keeps reconnecting. Sales on the call, need quick swarm.

sam: What exact error do they see?

maria: From their iOS webview: "Unexpected end of JSON input" right after a partial SSE event. Server logs show 200 then connection closed ~350ms in. Also seeing occasional 429 spikes.

aj: Can you paste the raw bytes from the server side? Suspect proxy buffering + chunk boundaries splitting UTF-8 or JSON object. Also which SDK/version?

maria: They're on iOS SDK v0.9.3 (webview wrapper). Pasted server-side snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
transfer-encoding: chunked
cache-control: no-cache

data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"This is a long response that gets streamed in parts",
data: {"id":"msg_123","text":"...continued chunk 2..."


// connection closed by peer here, no terminating newline or closing brace
```

maria: You can see the JSON object is split across chunk boundaries and the final closing brace never hits the client.

li: We're also seeing 429s from the rate limiter for tenant=zenith around the same timestamps. x-rate-limit-reset: 14s. Could be retries compounding the issue.

aj: Quick mitigation suggestions: 1) disable proxy buffering on the streaming route (nginx: proxy_buffering off;) so chunk boundaries are preserved; 2) emit a small server-side heartbeat event every 15s (e.g., "event: keepalive
 data: {}

"); 3) update client to tolerate partial frames and ignore empty data lines.

sam: Can we roll a canary to disable buffering for the demo tenant only? Low risk and fast to test.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: config/nginx/zenith-disable-buffering @ sha:abc123 (rolling 1/3 hosts) :rocket:

maria: I asked the customer to upgrade to SDK v0.9.4 which has reconnect/backoff fixes and better SSE parsing. They will test in ~10m.

maria: Quick follow-up from them: after the canary and SDK update, the JSON parse error disappeared but they see occasional blank keepalive lines that their parser chokes on.

aj: If the client chokes on blank lines, either send an explicit "event: keepalive
 data: {}

" or update the parser to skip empty data segments. Also confirm the proxy isn't inserting extra CRLFs.

li: Temporarily lifted rate limits for tenant=zenith for 30m to avoid retry storms while they validate. Monitoring dashboards: https://redwood.internal/alerts/zenith-poc :eyes:

sam: If it recurs, let's capture a tcpdump and full request/response capture. aj, can you add --sse-frame-log to the runtime so we can see exact byte frames?

aj: Yep, adding verbose SSE framing logs and a patch to the runtime to emit 'sse-frame' traces. Will roll patch in ~30m to the canary pool.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update AE notes and the support ticket. Will mark this thread resolved if the customer confirms green after the next test. :thumbsup:
